capabilities.name: Create Image
capabilities.description: Generate stunning images from text descriptions

inputs.label: Prompt
hintExamples: Kala Imagine — use natural sentences: subject first, then action, then setting and light. A red fox in dewy tall grass at sunrise, mist along the ridge, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, lifelike fur detail.
Describe only what you want. Cozy Scandinavian reading nook, oak shelves, one warm pendant, late sun through linen curtains.
Kala Dream — lead with the hero subject. Neon diner corner, wet asphalt mirrors pink and teal signage, cinematic color grade, 35mm street photo.
Text in the picture — put the words in quotes. A corner bodega with a painted sign reading "OPEN LATE", sodium vapor glow, drizzle, documentary mood.

capabilities.name: Edit Image
capabilities.description: Transform and restyle your photos with AI

inputs.label: Edit prompt
hintExamples: Kala Imagine — state the change, then what stays: Change the jacket to deep navy wool; keep pose, face, hands, lighting, and background unchanged.
Several photos — name each one. Person from the first image wearing the jacket palette from the second; preserve identity and skin texture.
Precise local edit: Remove the backpack strap from the left shoulder only; keep fabric folds and shadows consistent.
Text swap: Replace the headline with "HALF OFF" using the same font weight, color, alignment, and perspective as the original lettering.

capabilities.name: Inpaint & Erase
capabilities.description: Remove objects or fill areas seamlessly

models.description: Highly realistic videos with audio support.

inputs.label: Video prompt
hintExamples: CineReal — motion and camera first, then mood. Slow push-in on rising steam from a mug, warm practical lights, shallow depth, quiet morning ambience.
Cinemotion Pro — name the action in a few clauses. Two friends on a rooftop at dusk, city lights behind them, a small laugh, handheld feel.
Scene beats in plain language: Coastal drone glide at sunset, waves rolling on cliffs, gulls crossing frame, light film grain, steady gimbal feel.
Short clause chain: Rain-streaked window, taxi lights sliding past, silhouette turns toward camera, neo-noir teal and orange grade.

models.name: Cinemotion Pro
models.description: High quality image-to-video with optional end frame.

models.name: CineReal
models.description: Highly realistic motion from one image, or between two keyframes (optional end frame and guidance audio from + or the attach sheet).

models.name: AnimateFlow
models.description: Smooth, high-quality motion for vivid videos

models.name: RefMotion
models.description: Create videos from text with reference image/video.

inputs.label: Motion prompt
hintExamples: Image-to-video — subtle motion reads best: Gentle breathing, slow blink, hair drifting slightly, soft cloth movement, same framing and focus.
Cinemotion Pro — name visible motion cues: Camera eases left while leaves flutter in backlight, dust in a sunbeam, micro handheld sway.
CineReal photo to photo — bridge start and end: Smooth ease from standing into sitting, keep wardrobe, lighting, and background continuity.
Avoid huge object swaps; describe micro-motion and light: River highlights shimmer, eyelids heavy after sundown, fabric responds to a light breeze.

capabilities.name: Expand Scene
capabilities.description: Extend your image beyond its borders

inputs.label: Scene detail (optional)
hintExamples: Scene Expander — ask for a seamless continuation: Extend sky and distant ridgeline with the same cloudy atmosphere and brush texture as the original.
Match perspective and palette: Continue the cobblestone street and storefronts with the same vanishing point and warm lamp tones.
Optional — leave blank for a neutral expand, or add: More foreground meadow with soft wildflowers, same golden-hour haze as the plate.
Seamless wings: Widen the theater stage with matching velvet drapes and haze; do not introduce new characters or props.
